title.narrative: Support for the Modernization of the Technological Infrastructure and Education of the Province of Córdoba, Argentina

description.narrative: The Project Support for the Modernization of the Technological Infrastructure of the Province of Córdoba, has the following objectives: a) support the modernization of the Technological Infrastructure of the Government of the Province of Córdoba, Argentina and b) contribute to the pedagogical application of information and communication technologies in the teaching and learning processes of the primary and secondary levels of the public schools of Córdoba. the province.
